intent: Labelled synthetic captures of a dealer's listing for ticket 115. Every listing, dealer and VIN is invented for testing; none is a real ad. Each fixture is paired with dealer paperwork whose vehicle price is $25,000 (2500000 cents) for VIN 1HGCM82633A004352, the agreed car in the acceptance tests.

fixtures.label: matching-price
fixtures.description: The ad shows the same price as the paperwork.
fixtures.text:

VIN: 1HGCM82633A004352
Mileage: 98,200 miles
Dealer: North Branch Motors
